verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's own docs point to a Batch Processing API for high-volume processing and asynchronous screening for high-volume scenarios. Bulk data extraction is also available through date-ranged exports across several resource types and CSV transaction export. However, the Batch Processing API is only a one-line mention, and the monitoring endpoints are explicitly single-customer. missing for 10: documented batch API details (payloads, limits, item counts), bulk case/alert decisioning or bulk monitor/unmonitor actions, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk operations.
